captions.detailed: A flat-incline utility gym bench consisting of a black rectangular base frame, a large rectangular backrest cushion, and a smaller seat cushion. A support ladder mechanism sits underneath the backrest for angle adjustment, complete with a prominent red pop-pin selector knob on the side. The backrest is hinged to rotate upward relative to the seat, while the seat can pivot independently, and the rear ladder support swings on its own lower frame pivot.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a flat-to-incline utility workout bench. The bench must feature a sturdy black base frame, a hinged backrest pad, a separate seat pad, a rear ladder support arm, and a red pop-pin selector knob. Ensure you define the articulations for the backrest rotation, the seat pivot, the ladder support rotation, and the prismatic sliding of the selector pin.
captions.factory: Construct the base frame using box primitives welded into a rectangular ground footprint with vertical uprights. Model the seat and backrest cushions as chamfered or rounded boxes attached to underlying structural channel bars. Build the ladder support assembly using parallel rectangular tubes connected by cylindrical cross-rungs. Define revolute joints for the seat pivot, the backrest hinge, and the ladder support's lower frame pivot, and add a prismatic joint for the red cylindrical pop-pin knob along its lateral axis.
